description: "1.2.3".match?(/\A\d+(\.\d+)*\z/) -- `regexp_lit`, the head, and the cheapest eliminator: `String#match?` is total and returns `Bool`. That makes it the right first rung of the regexp story, because it needs a type for a `Regexp` value and nothing else -- `Ty` has no `Regexp`, so this rung's whole demand is one `.cls` row.
